status_note: Fixed upstream: on 55.0.0 `DataFrame.to_arrow_table()` concatenates the batches.
summary: A `UNION ALL` gives record batches whose schemas differ in nullability (and, for a recursive CTE, in column names), and `DataFrame.to_arrow_table()` fails to concatenate them: `Schema at index 1 was different`.
repro: `ctx.sql('select 1 as a union all select null').to_arrow_table()` fails on 51.0.0 (`a: int64 not null vs a: int64`) and works on 55.0.0.
handling: None: sverify no longer runs DataFusion. The entry records the bug.
found_by: audit of DataFusion's limits on the shared path (2026-11-08)
